plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's depth and power. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The harder part is that the same intensity can turn destructive. You may provoke each other in ways that escalate beyond what either of you intended, where a small disagreement becomes something neither of you can stop, and the heat that pulled you together starts to feel frightening instead of exciting. The drive to be close can become a need to control. Wanting can curdle into possessiveness, jealousy, the sense of being watched or owned. The connection can lock into a cycle where things break down hard and then pull back together harder, and each time it gets a little more difficult to leave.
advice: Aim the energy at something outside the two of you, and be honest about what it brings out in you. This works when the intensity builds something. When it starts to scare you, when the fights leave damage, when you find yourself managing this person's reactions or your own just to keep the peace, that is not a phase to push through. Intensity is never a reason to stay somewhere that is hurting you.
